name: dsfr-ai-components
description: Système de Design de l'État (DSFR) component registry for AI coding agents. Self-contained, accessible French government components with full adaptation and coordination metadata.

designSystem.name: Système de Design de l'État (DSFR)
designSystem.notes: Ground truth: @gouvfr/dsfr installed as an EXACT devDependency (npm install needs --ignore-scripts; the package postinstall expects a DSFR app). TWO stylesheets are required: the core bundle plus dist/utility/icons/icons.min.css — fr-icon-* classes exist only in the icon utility bundle, so a core-only check misreads them as drift.

metadataCategories.discovery: Facets for filtering in code (not sent to model)
metadataCategories.selection: useWhen/avoidWhen — helps choose the right component

highContrast.description: forced-colors / high-contrast mode support (DSFR testé en modes contraste élevé)

darkMode.description: DSFR ships official light and dark themes via the fr-theme data attribute

gaps.reason: DSFR has no official autocomplete component; the France-services locator is a custom composition
JS-heavy navigation observed live but deferred in the initial build

staticView.note: Resolved-view generation input (see _base/generate-resolved-view.mjs). Tiles are self-contained; no design-system CSS injection needed.
